ov: Wild pigs of Sulawesi and nearby Indonesian islands, also called deer-pigs. A male’s upper tusks grow straight up through the skin of its snout and curve back toward its forehead. Babirusas are active by day and live in tropical rainforest along rivers.
rg: Sulawesi, the Togian and Sula islands and Buru, in Indonesia.
df: Leaves, roots, fruit and animal material; their strong jaws crack hard nuts easily.
fx: Groups of females and young can number up to 84, while adult males mostly live alone.
Cave paintings of babirusas on Sulawesi are at least 35,400 years old.
